reasoning: The whole turn is one person wanting to know something: what those shells are, whether they are just programs, whether it was all thought through, and which code is running. Four sentences, one act — every clause asks about the same thing and none of them adds a second act; nothing here is voiced as a possibility for later, nothing reports a new fact, nothing settles an open choice, and nothing tells work in flight to change its goal, its constraints or its state. 'Ты все продумал?' reads as curiosity about what is already going, not as a caution or a correction — it changes no goal and drops no requirement. So the answer to the first question is that no work was requested, and the second question — what does it touch — never comes up. Answering it may take reading, and reading is not work; turning the question into a task because the answer took effort is exactly the failure this skill exists to prevent. No sheet, no checkpoint, no specialists: just a plain answer naming what is actually running.
